original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-lambda-trace}
Let $f : P\to P$ be an endomorphism of the finite projective
$\Lambda[G]$-module $P$. Then
$$
\text{Tr}_{\Lambda}(f; P) = \# G \cdot \text{Tr}_\Lambda^G(f; P).
$$
